Question: As-Salam-Walaekum. I am 23 year old Male,recently married.I want to know the dua for Gussal as soon as possible please provide that in english or hindi or arabic I cannot able read urdu language. Answer ID: 14388 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1247/1013=D/1430) It is makrooh to recite any dua while performing ghusl ; since one stands at a place where used water falls. Likewise, commonly people take bath in the state of uncovering their satr (hidden parts of body), in this state also, reciting any dua is makrooh : وقال فی نور الایضاح: ویستحب ان لا یتکلم بکلام معہ ولو دعاء، قال فی المراقی: لانہ فی مصب الاقذار ویکرہ مع کشف العورۃ حاشیۃ طحطاوی۔ One should recite only bismillah ( بسم اللہ الرحمن الرحیم ) before taking off the clothes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
